versions.text: See AMC.595 (a) (a) The structural design of the UAV and the integrity of onboard equipment must be consistent with the maximum deceleration due to (1) the deployment of the parachute (2) the impact of the UAV on the ground taking into account any shock absorber system, for the worst case conditions, agreed to with the Certifying Authority. (b) The maximum deceleration forces must take into account all the conditions under which the deployment of the parachute is possible within the flight envelope protection as prescribed in USAR.334, especially if the parachute is to be used under emergency conditions.

See AMC.U595 (a) (a) The structural design of the UA and the integrity of onboard equipment must be consistent with the maximum deceleration due to: (1) the deployment of the parachute. (2) the impact of the UA on the ground taking into account any shock absorber system, for the worst case conditions, agreed to with the Certifying Authority. (b) The maximum deceleration forces must take into account all the conditions under which the deployment of the parachute is possible within the flight envelope protection as prescribed in USAR.U334, especially if the parachute is to be used under emergency conditions.
